mapper.select: SELECT id AS event_id, article_id, meta_version FROM article_outbox WHERE available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY available_at,id LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE article_outbox SET claim_token=#{token}, available_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM article_outbox WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token}
mapper.update: UPDATE article_outbox SET claim_token=NULL, available_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{delay} SECOND) WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token}
